## ChatOSS v1.9.2

### New
- **App Store** in the Apps app — Store | Library tabs, AI-powered app review (DeepSeek V4 Flash), GitHub-link listings with Trending/New/category filters. (1.9.1)
- **Window restore safety** — never restores a 0×0 primed record as an invisible ghost window. (1.9.1)

### Fixed (this release)
- **"Verified." empty-response bug** — degenerate stub replies after stream dedup/restart are detected and dropped/re-prompted instead of leaving the user with a bare "Verified."
- **Plan bullet points** — the plan UI now reliably marks steps complete and tracks the current step as the agent works.
- **run_command tool-call styling** — terminal-style blocks in chat responses across all panes.
- **Sidebar flicker** — recency sort now reorders only on user clicks, not agent activity, so scrolling during an agent run is stable.
- **Orchestrator batches parallel sub-agent spawns** in one turn; no longer spawns one-per-turn.
- **Stale "Waiting for N sub-agents" count** — derived from live statuses now.
- **Orchestrator no longer ends its turn prematurely** while sub-agents run.
- **Sub-agent process hardened** — no more heavy MANDATORY preamble; no spurious restarts (only orchestrator-detected unrecoverable loops respawn).
- **Sub-agent fumbling** — declined commands are never retried; failing inspection is abandoned for direct file reads.
- Sub-agent infrastructure: build-doctor.sh allowed on the sub-agent allowlist; reliable tsx test runner guidance.
- **outputGuard regex** — "Verified — no issues found." stub now matches (space before the em-dash).

### Platforms
- macOS: universal (x86_64 + arm64), Developer ID signed + notarized + stapled
- Windows + Linux: built by release CI
